info.title: Machine Sensor Log Data Retrieval
info.description: A service that retrieves real-time machine sensor log data from specified file paths.

get.description: Fetches the machine sensor log data from the specified file path provided via query parameter.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Absolute path to the machine sensor log file to be retrieved.

200.description: Successful retrieval of machine sensor log data.

404.description: Machine sensor log file not found.

error.example: File not found at specified path.
